WITH RECURSIVE call_chain AS (
  -- Start from all direct call sites of _send_single_request within the file
  SELECT caller_symbol_id
  FROM code.calls
  WHERE callee_symbol_id = 'httpx/_client.py::Client._send_single_request'
    AND callee_name = '_send_single_request'
    AND resolution = 'same_file'
    AND call_kind = 'direct'
  UNION ALL
  -- Recurse: find callers of symbols already in the chain
  SELECT c.caller_symbol_id
  FROM code.calls c
  JOIN call_chain cc ON c.callee_symbol_id = cc.caller_symbol_id
  WHERE c.resolution = 'same_file'
    AND c.call_kind = 'direct'
    AND c.callee_name != '_send_single_request'
)
SELECT DISTINCT caller_symbol_id
FROM call_chain
ORDER BY caller_symbol_id;
